description: This Java class defines a ViewHolder for sharing links within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It manages UI elements related to sharing via links, including display logic for different share types, permissions, and branding.

classes.name: LinkShareViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class for displaying share links in the UI, handling different share types, permissions, and branding.

methods.name: LinkShareViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with a view or binding and context.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds an OCShare object and listener to the ViewHolder, updating UI elements based on share type and permissions.

methods.name: setPermissionName
methods.description: Sets the permission name text and visibility based on the share's permission and type.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to UI elements based on the provided color.
